device_topology.description: Same OutClaw/ codebase is deployed on multiple devices; per-device subtrees are runtime state, not separate repos.
device_topology.note: Per-device event logs (messages/*.json) are NOT included in the main source zip - see SWARM_TOPOLOGY.md section 3.

cloud_delivery.quota_strategy: Keep last 3 timestamped runs on Drive to stay within ~5 GB free on a personal Drive account; each run is ~1.2 GB combined.
cloud_delivery.notes: Writer-Owns discipline from SYNC_PROTOCOL.md is what makes Google Drive safe under rclone - moto4/a9 each write to their OWN subtree, so concurrent-push filename collisions are impossible. The canonical carrier is now known to be Drive; the earlier Termux /storage/emulated/0/* paths were a red herring.

exclusions.rationale: Reduce ingest payload, avoid binary bloat, keep history-bearing runtime state out of version control.

ingest_recommendations: Treat the main OutClaw zip as a single Python codebase for code-aware RAG; expect ~646 MB of source after exclusions (much larger than initially projected because OutClaw/ contains substantial non-Python content: 25 PDFs, 17 docx, 17 HTML, 251 .txt scout-data dumps, etc.). The diabetes limb bundle is ~598 MB - it deliberately KEEPS heavy binaries (.wav/.mp3/etc) since it is the 'bloat' limb.
Treat device event logs (sync_bus/<node>/messages/*.json) as a SEPARATE ingestion target tagged with origin_device.
The 'diabetes limb bundle' (extracted_legal_ai/, 734 MB vendored) should be ingested separately only if legal AI model context is needed downstream.
Architecture docs (SYNC_PROTOCOL, HYBRID_INTELLIGENCE, SWARM_TOPOLOGY) are high-signal anchor points for system-level questions about design intent.

blockers.issue: No per-device event-log zips included in this ingest push
blockers.details: Three layers were checked. (1) Termux Android shared-storage paths /storage/emulated/0/BleakNarratives, /storage/emulated/0/RootBase are not mounted on this Chromebook session. (2) SD-card path /storage/ED7B-AD5A/eoot/2026 is not mounted (SD not present). (3) The canonical Google Drive carrier outclaw-cloud:bleaknarratives/sync_bus/{moto4,a9}/ does not exist yet - peer devices have not pushed envelopes. Even with Drive access there is nothing to ingest for moto4/a9 at this time.
blockers.mitigation: There is no separate 'Moto 4 5g codebase' or 'Samsung A9 codebase' to ingest - moto4 and a9 are swarm NODES running the same OutClaw codebase (see SWARM_TOPOLOGY.md). The single OutClaw/ source tree IS in the main package. Once peer devices bring sync_bus_pull.sh online and push envelopes to Drive, follow the path documented in BLOCKER.md section 'How to ingest per-device event logs (future session)'.

deliverables_record.size_note: Main zip is ~646 MB and limb bundle ~598 MB. Mutable in future runs via the .log / .venv exclusion pattern in scripts/package_for_ingest.sh.

cloud_upload_record.delivery_method: Manual rclone copyto -v after the push_ingest_to_cloud.sh script silently no-op'd (rclone exited 0 but bytes didn't land - Drive resumable-upload claim-success-before-finalize pattern). Subsequent script invocations use the patched copyto (per-file byte verification vs Drive lsjson) to prevent recurrence.
